pages.title: BedWars - Introduction
pages.content:
## BedWars

Protect your team's bed. Break theirs. That is the whole war.

BedWars runs on the dedicated arena islands (built from the `bedwars-*` schematics): every team gets a home island with a **bed**, two **iron generators** and one **gold generator**, a shop marker and a team chest. Diamond and emerald islands float between the teams - those are the mid-game fights.

**Getting in**

* `/ih bw list` — the arenas on the server and who is waiting.
* `/ih bw join <arena>` — stand in the lobby circle and wait. When enough players are in, a 10-second countdown starts and the islands open.
* `/ih bw kit` — pick your kit before the drop (see [Kits](/wiki?page=hihou-kits)).

**Winning and losing**

* With your bed alive you respawn on your island after a 5-second death timer.
* Lose the bed and every death is permanent - you flip to spectator and watch through the sidebar.
* The last team with a live bed (or just live players) wins, followed by a 15-second fireworks show in the team colours before everyone is handed back to the survival world.
* Nobody is winning fast enough? The clock decides: at 25 minutes every remaining bed crumbles (sudden death), and at 40 minutes the game is called.

During a match a **sidebar** replaces your normal tab list: teams, beds, the match clock, the mode and your own purse of ore. It leaves again the moment you leave the game.

[In the match](/wiki?page=hihou-play) · [Shop & upgrades](/wiki?page=hihou-shop) · [Kits](/wiki?page=hihou-kits) · [Modes & rewards](/wiki?page=hihou-modes) · [Staff: arenas](/wiki?page=hihou-staff)

pages.title: In the match
pages.content:
## In the match

**Ore** is money. The pads on your island print it while the match runs:

| Generator | Drops | Every | Up to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Iron (×2 per team) | 2 iron | 2 s | 32 lying around |
| Gold | 2 gold | 6 s | 7 lying around |
| Diamond (mid) | 1 diamond | 30 s → 20 s at 6 min → 15 s at 18 min | 4 |
| Emerald (mid) | 1 emerald | 70 s → 50 s at 12 min → 30 s at 24 min | 4 |

You pay with the ore you physically carry - pick it up off the pad or spend it straight from the pile.

**The bed** can only be destroyed by enemies: breaking it, sleeping in it, TNT next to it, or a well-timed **Bed Breach Charge** from the shop. Wool around it is normal; wool *on* it is a crime scene (buy shears).

**Dying** costs 5 seconds and nothing else - your kit and carried ore wait at base as long as the bed stands. If you quit or crash mid-match, `/ih bw rejoin` pulls you back into the same game.

**Spectating your friends**: after elimination, `/ih bw follow <player>` parks you next to anyone still fighting.

**Parties**: `/ih bw party invite <player>` sends a clickable invite; whoever accepts is placed on the same team as you at balance time. `/ih bw party leave` opts out again.

**Team chest**: every island has one that only your team can open during the match. It pays out: when the game finishes, whatever is still inside drops on top of the chest instead of vanishing.

**The sidebar** (in-match tab list) shows teams and their bed status, the clock, the current mode and your own purse. `/ih bw stats` or `/ih bw stats top` work from anywhere and report your season numbers.

Back to [BedWars](/wiki?page=hihou-intro) · [Shop & upgrades](/wiki?page=hihou-shop)

pages.title: The shop
pages.content:
Right-click your team's **shop marker** (an anvil at base) or type `/ih bw shop`. Six tabs, paid with the ore you carry - no coins, no shopkeeper, no refund games.

**Blocks**

| Item | Costs |
|---|---|
| White wool ×16 | 4 iron |
| White wool ×64 | 12 iron |
| Glass ×8 | 4 iron |
| Ladder ×16 | 3 gold |
| Oak planks ×32 | 6 iron |

**Armor**

| Item | Costs |
|---|---|
| Leather helmet | 10 iron |
| Chain leggings | 15 iron |
| Chain chestplate | 20 iron |
| Iron helmet | 4 gold |
| Iron chestplate | 3 diamonds |
| Iron leggings | 2 diamonds |

**Weapons**

| Item | Costs |
|---|---|
| Wooden sword | 5 iron |
| Stone sword | 10 iron |
| Stone axe | 12 iron |
| Iron sword | 6 gold |
| Diamond sword | 6 diamonds |
| Bow | 4 gold |
| Arrows ×12 | 2 gold |
| Shears | 6 iron |
| TNT | 3 emeralds |
| Ender pearl | 3 diamonds |
| **Bed Breach Charge** | 8 emeralds |

The breach charge is the siege tool: right-click it within 16 blocks of an enemy bed and that bed is gone - it counts and pays exactly like breaking it by hand.

**Food**: bread ×4 (3 iron), cooked chicken ×4 (2 gold), cooked beef ×4 (3 gold), golden carrots ×2 (5 gold), cake (10 iron).

**Potions**: Healing splash (1 emerald), Fire Resistance (4 gold), Leaping (2 emeralds).

Back to [Shop & team upgrades](/wiki?page=hihou-shop)

pages.title: Team upgrades
pages.content:
The **Upgrades** tab spends **emeralds for the whole team** - bought once, they hold for the rest of the match:

| Upgrade | Levels | Cost per level | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Protection | 3 | 2 / 4 / 6 | Resistance I on the team |
| Sharpness | 3 | 2 / 4 / 7 | Strength on the team |
| Forge | 3 | 3 / 5 / 8 | Your iron gens tick faster and richer |
| Healers | 2 | 4 / 7 | Team-wide Regeneration pulse every 45 s |
| Trap | 2 | 4 / 6 | Intruders within 6 blocks of your spawn are slowed and announced |
| Auto-Earn | 1 | 6 | Your team's iron and gold fly straight into a teammate's pockets |
| Shockwave | 2 | 5 / 8 | Attackers sometimes get blasted off you |

pages.title: Kits
pages.content:
## Kits

Pick one with `/ih bw kit <name>` - in the lobby or any time during the match. The choice is yours until you change it, and a fresh copy is handed out at **every spawn and respawn**, so dying never leaves you empty-handed.

| Kit | In your hands from the drop |
|---|---|
| **classic** | Stone sword - a fair fight to start the war |
| **builder** | Wooden axe + 16 white wool on the hotbar - bridge first, fight later |
| **miner** | Iron pickaxe - the diamond islands will thank you |
| **archer** | Bow + 12 arrows - keep them honest from 20 blocks |

There is no penalty for swapping mid-match; the next respawn simply hands you the new kit.

Back to [BedWars](/wiki?page=hihou-intro) · [Shop & upgrades](/wiki?page=hihou-shop)

pages.title: Match modes
pages.content:
Every game rolls a mode (the server can keep this off, then it is always classic). The current mode is announced at the drop and shown on the in-match sidebar:

| Mode | Twist |
|---|---|
| classic | Beds, standard rules - the war as intended |
| no beds | Nobody has a bed; every life is final from the first drop |
| double iron | Team generators throw 4 iron per tick - bridges fly everywhere |
| need for speed | Everyone gets a standing Swiftness dose for the whole match - bridges go up fast and retreats are optional |

Staff can force the next game's mode with `/ih bw mode <arena> <classic|no-beds|double-iron|speed>`.

Back to [Match modes, stats & rewards](/wiki?page=hihou-modes)

pages.title: Season stats
pages.content:
`/ih bw stats` — your own season line: games, wins, kills, deaths, beds broken and coins earned.
`/ih bw stats <player>` — look someone else up.
`/ih bw stats top` — the season leaderboard by wins.
The staff command `/ih bw season` starts a new season and clears the books.

Back to [Match modes, stats & rewards](/wiki?page=hihou-modes)

pages.title: Rewards
pages.content:
BedWars pays into the server economy (the same money as the shop and the train network):

| Feat | Coins |
|---|---|
| Kill | 5 |
| Bed destroyed | 10 |
| Winning the match | 25 |

You get a chat line for each ("+10 BedWars reward (bed)."). The numbers live in the plugin config (`bw-rewards.*`) and can be tuned by staff without a restart.

Back to [BedWars](/wiki?page=hihou-intro) · [Staff: arenas](/wiki?page=hihou-staff)

pages.title: Staff - building and running arenas
pages.content:
## Staff: building and running arenas

A BedWars arena is a named collection of points: a lobby and spectator spot, a bounding region for the map-reset, and per team a spawn, bed, shop marker and team chest, plus generator pads. All of it is wired in-game with `/ih bw` commands (staff only unless stated).

**1. Build the map.** The eight `bedwars-*` schematic parts (lobby, four team islands, two diamond mids, one emerald mid) live in `plugins/WorldEdit/schematics/`. Paste them with WorldEdit (`//schem load bedwars-01-rood` + `//paste -a`) in the order printed by `python -I scripts/make_bedwars_arena.py` - the islands share one layout, so keep the spacing from the checklist.

**2. Register the arena.**

* `/ih bw create <name>` then `/ih bw set <arena> spawn|spec|center|size|end <value>` — lobby spot, spectator spot and the reset region (center + radius). `end <seconds>` moves the sudden-death moment when every standing bed crumbles (default 1500 s = 25 min).
* `/ih bw team <arena> add <team> <color>` — red/blue/green/yellow by default, any name works; then stand on the spot and set each point: `spawn <team>`, `bed <team>` (look at the bed), `shop <team>` (look at the anvil), `chest <team>` (look at the team chest). `del <team>` removes.
* `/ih bw gen <arena> add iron|gold <team>|diamond|emerald` — stand on the pad; iron and gold need their owning team, mids do not.

**3. Snapshot before the first game.** `/ih bw snapshot <arena> [lo] [hi]` captures every non-air block in the region. After each match the reset restores **exactly** that state - placed, broken and blasted blocks all return. Take the snapshot while the arena is pristine; without it the reset falls back to the lite path (own placements only).

**4. Running games.**

* `/ih bw list` / `/ih bw info <arena>` — what exists and how it is wired.
* `/ih bw start <arena> [seconds]` / `/ih bw stop <arena>` — force the countdown or end a match; matches also auto-start when the lobby fills the minimum.
* `/ih bw mode <arena> <mode>` — force the next game's twist.
* `/ih bw season` — new season, stats cleared.
* `/ih bw delete <arena>` — forget it (the blocks stay; the reset restores what the snapshot knows).

Config keys (survive restarts): `bw-rewards.kill/bed/win` (coins), `bw-random-modes` (roll a twist per game, default on).
